item.tib: g.yung drung sems dpa'i nyes ltung sbyong ba'i gzungs chog
item.coloph: kho bo g.yung drung bdud 'dul thogs med rtsal lam/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal/ mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa sogs gsang nang dang phyi yi ming thog pa'i bdag nyid can la/ gshen rab gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin chen po gyer spungs dran pas/ bka' gter ma bu sdeb can kha sbyor du rtsal ba 'thob pa/ lcags rta'i zla tshes bzang por gtan la phab pa'o//
